display_long_description:
circle chaos is a fast-paced vr party game inspired by cube runners, built with gtag-style locomotion for full arm-swing chaos.

jump, climb, launch yourself, and survive through a bunch of different game modes that all play totally differently. whether you’re messing around with friends or trying to lock in and win, it’s pure movement-based mayhem.

gamemodes: 
- horror – not super scary, but huge, fun, and tense in all the right ways
- hangout – chill on 3 small islands, perfect for messing around and talking
- maze – get lost, split up, or race to the end
- robbery – currently broken, coming soon ;-;
- speeding wall – react fast or get wiped
- glass bridge – trust your instincts… or fall

features:
- gtag-style locomotion
- multiplayer chaos with friends
- inspired by cube runners
- fast, replayable game modes
- simple to learn, hard to master

if you like movement-based vr games, chaotic multiplayer, and clutch moments, circle chaos delivers.

run fast.
trust no floor.
embrace the chaos B)
